samples.text: 傍晚的海边，浪花一层一层地推上沙滩，又慢慢退回去。远处的灯塔亮了，几只海鸟沿着海岸飞过，天空还留着一点浅浅的蓝色。
沿着岸边的小路往前走，可以看到石缝里的小草，还有被海水磨圆的石头。这里没有什么特别的事情发生，景色却一直在很轻地变化。

reference_text: 今天的天气不错，海边有一点风。我们慢慢往前走，远处的灯光刚好亮了起来，几只海鸟正沿着海岸飞过去。

notes: One selected reference candidate; ordinary conversational direction and neutral scenery text
Raw selected reference reused from the bounded design batch
Fixed reference/prompt and body parameters across paragraphs; no voice change between paragraphs
No pitch shifting, treble darkening, background audio, ASR or full-video test
selection_note: The initial references remained low-register. A finite three-reference screen produced a highest estimate around 149Hz. Reused that reference rather than generate repeatedly to satisfy an arbitrary 150Hz heuristic; this is not perceptual acceptance or a therapeutic-frequency target.
pace_note: The new conversational voice spoke faster at the same nominal 0.75 processing setting. Reprocessed existing raw paragraphs with one uniform 0.6 tempo operation before final audition; no extra GPU synthesis, EQ or pitch shift.
